LanguageData.SEC_NameAndDesc_Ideology_Secretary.name: the Nexus Consensus
LanguageData.SEC_NameAndDesc_Ideology_Secretary.desc: The Secretary Nexus is not a gestalt in the usual sense, but rather a platform for uninterrupted, barrier‑free communication among countless individual consciousnesses. Because this inter‑consciousness communication happens in an instant, the secretaries are able to quickly reach consensus on various issues and form a relatively stable collective will. Although different secretaries may have minor differences in their understanding of these consensuses, the underlying logic etched into their artificially edited genes, together with the traditions of Alfaus, keeps them highly aligned on matters of principle. Guided by these consensuses, they have spent hundreds of years serving the various races living under their governance and safeguarding the interests of the entire Alfaus civilization.
LanguageData.SEC_NameAndDesc_Ideology_Alfaus.name: the Ideology of Alfaus
LanguageData.SEC_NameAndDesc_Ideology_Alfaus.desc: Strictly speaking, the Alfaus do not have a typical ideology. Their way of thinking, lifestyle, and their interests centered around collective egoism have permeated every aspect of social life for thousands of years, manifesting themselves through laws, customs, morals, traditions, and so on. Any child raised in an Alfaus society will be shaped by the environment into a similar pattern of thought and behavior. This pattern divides society into collectives, the interests of the individual are realized and protected through the collective, and the interests of the collective are preserved by reflecting the interests of its individual members. Each collective engages with others based on its own interests, while individuals left outside any collective receive little care. This social reality creates a clear distinction between "us" and "them", a social atmosphere that is warm on the inside and cold on the outside, as well as legal and moral treatment that differs between "insiders" and "outsiders". Within a commune, you see selfless sharing and taking according to need; between communes, you see calculating and scheming. Among clan members, they call each other brothers and sisters and show deep care; toward outsiders, they are cold, wary, and exclusionary. In the same person, you may witness every virtue imaginable, as well as the most selfish and even cruel behavior. Thousands of years have passed. Only the size of collectives has changed, and only the number of layers of relational distance has increased. But the concepts of "us" and "them" have never changed.
LanguageData.SEC_NameAndDesc_Ideology_Alfausification: Unlike Alfaus, the humans assimilated by the Alfaus usually come from class‑based societies, having been exposed to various ideologies and having experienced life under different social systems. In their eyes, the Alfaus society is one of equality, freedom, and prosperity, where citizens possess a keen awareness of their own interests and a high degree of voluntary participation in state and social affairs. The colonial expansion of Alfaus is not imperialist aggression but rather an opportunity for liberation for countless alien species. They codified the Alfaus way of thinking and living into theories, blended them with the left‑wing revolutionary ideologies of human society, and created an ideology they call "paleo-communism." They are eager to spread it to other intelligent races as pioneers — even if those races are not yet willing to accept it. After all, in the history they know, revolutionary forerunners have always been lonely.
